description: Solana account inventory: SOL balance, every SPL token account (Token and Token-2022 programs) with mint, amount, decimals and frozen state, token name, symbol, USD price and value for the largest holdings (Jupiter token data), and the latest transaction signatures with time and status. Read from Solana RPC. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
